summary: Flat kerb on a quiet street with parked cars; homes 17-19 m away.
reasons: Homes 17-19 m away on all sides

best_section.where: east kerb of Manchester Terrace on the flat top of the hill, beside the tree strip

drivers.seclusion: Mapped dwellings 17-19 m away on this side; houses across the road are similar, screened by trees and hedges.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on both sides; room to stop beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Residents' cars line the street, so a van would blend in loosely.

flags: Dwellings 11-21 m from kerb along the whole stretch
Very steep either side of the flat: up to 23% grade
sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb from the east in the morning; open to the west.
